description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericXaResource' that implements the XAResource interface, providing a foundational implementation for distributed transaction resources. It manages transaction enlistment, start/end handling, timeout management, and supports integration with Java Transaction API (JTA) for transaction coordination and recovery.

classes.name: GenericXaResource
classes.description: An abstract implementation of the XAResource interface, supporting management of a single transaction and handling timeout events. It extends Thread to run timeout logic asynchronously.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists this resource in the current transaction, obtaining the TransactionManager, and enlisting if active.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists this resource in the passed transaction.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the XA transaction handling with the provided Xid and flag, spawning a thread for timeout if necessary.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the XA transaction handling for the given Xid.

methods.name: forget
methods.description: Instructs the resource manager to forget about a heuristically completed transaction identified by Xid.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the resource for commit, confirming the Xid matches.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Recovers transaction identifiers that are in a heuristic or in-doubt state.

methods.name: isSameRM
methods.description: Determines if this resource manager is the same as the one referenced.

methods.name: getTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current transaction timeout setting.

methods.name: setTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Sets the transaction timeout duration in seconds.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Returns the associated Transaction object.

methods.name: setTransaction
methods.description: Associates a Transaction object with this resource.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the resource.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks whether the resource is active.

methods.name: setXid
methods.description: Assigns an Xid to this resource.

methods.name: getXid
methods.description: Retrieves the current Xid.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Abstract method to commit the transaction, implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Abstract method to rollback the transaction, implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: runOnTimeout
methods.description: Hook method invoked when a transaction times out; can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Thread method that handles transaction timeout waiting and timeout processing.
